set.body:
Problem: external_evidence() in tools/ci/finalize_first_level_release.py labels even not-a-url as verified.
Files: tools/ci/finalize_first_level_release.py, new stdlib tests, docs/release-assurance.md.
Implement a small versioned JSON evidence input, not network calls in the pure validator. Fields: kind, repository, candidate_commit, observed_at, source_url, payload_path, payload_sha256 and kind-specific data. CI/regeneration evidence additionally records workflow identity, run_id, run_attempt, head_sha, status and conclusion; regeneration records the reference-lock and generated fixture hashes. Branch-policy evidence records branch, policy snapshot hash and the expected required checks. Payload paths are relative to the evidence bundle; reject missing/hash-mismatched files and path escape.
States: absent=unverified; a legacy URL alone=provided; valid failure evidence=failed; verified only when parsed payload facts satisfy the contract for the requested candidate and repository. A bare assertion status=verified is not sufficient. Unknown/malformed/stale/wrong-SHA data remains ineligible. Bind branch evidence to the inspected candidate/branch; do not require branch API payloads to contain a commit field they do not have.
Acceptance: offline tests for missing/empty/malformed URL, URL-only input, foreign repository, wrong commit, queued/in-progress/failed/skipped runs, absent regeneration artifact, tampered payload, missing required check and a valid bundle of each kind. Run python3 -S -m unittest tools/ci/test_first_level_release.py. Update docs to distinguish provided and verified. Keep ordinary PR tests offline; never print credentials. P4.4f/g supply real evidence later.
set.title: P4.4d: replace URL-presence verification with a tested external evidence contract
